name: Alpha Philterbeast is brewed with 3 herbs and gets age counters
notes: Alpha Philterbeast is an EXALTED (advanced element) ALLY card, so the starting champion's Subcards are patched with a real EXALTED champion (Mordred, Fated Luminary) to unlock element access. Three herb tokens (Blightroot, Manaroot, Fraysia) are seeded onto the field to pay the Brew - Three Herbs alternate cost. Materializing answers YES to the Brew declaration, then picks the three herb objects one at a time via the BrewSelectHerb MZCHOOSE loop; the herbs are sacrificed (tokens cease to exist rather than moving to the graveyard, so the graveyard count stays 0 while the field count drops from 4 to 2). Because the card was brewed, its On Enter effect puts two age counters on it. Only the base Brew + age-counter effect is covered; the passive reactive-age and power/life-scaling clauses are out of scope.

rulesClauses: On Enter: If CARDNAME was brewed, put two age counters on it.
